# Hibiscus 0.8.29
This update makes model selection, workspace navigation, and the AI writing surface clearer and more predictable.
- AI provider settings can now show the complete matching model catalog, and model search filters the full catalog so hidden models remain discoverable. - Control-1 through Control-9 switch directly to the corresponding workspace in sidebar order. - When text is selected in a note, the assistant now shows an explicit preview and character count so it is clear that only the selected passage is being sent for editing. - The assistant composer now uses the full input area for typing and focus. Its Plus button opens a compact, arrowless action overlay directly above the control without moving the conversation. - Editor AI actions use the same flat, arrowless menu treatment, with cleaner row hover behavior. - Sidebar and editor toolbar icons have consistent hover styling; New Note now uses a balanced Plus icon. - Side panels use a clean white base in light appearance while preserving the configured translucency level. - Toolbar glass is clipped to its controls so it no longer casts a white veil across the first line of note text.

# Hibiscus 0.8.28
This release restores the fast, predictable note-creation flow and keeps Hibiscus ready when you want to capture something quickly.
- Command-N and New Note now create an Untitled note immediately in the normal editor. You can create as many new notes as you need, with reliable focus and uninterrupted typing. - The extra screen before the untitled editor has been removed. - Command-Delete now deletes a multi-note selection through one in-place confirmation instead of opening each note in a separate window. - Quick Capture keeps your text when you choose Improve or another AI action. Ordinary edits are no longer incorrectly labeled “Edited by AI.” - Settings can now show or hide the Hibiscus menu-bar icon without disabling global shortcuts. - Hibiscus can remain available after its windows are closed, keeping Quick Capture and global shortcuts ready. Choosing Quit still exits the app. - Compact on-device Apple dictation now stays in its focused recording flow, including while microphone and speech permissions are being granted. - The Founder offer is now the first and default perpetual-license option. Checkout uses fixed USD pricing, supports promotion codes, and works from the Hibiscus website. - License delivery is now durable and retryable. Approved no-cost family promotions are handled safely, while unrelated Stripe checkout events are ignored.

Hibiscus 0.8.27 fixes a license recovery problem that could affect customers updating from older signed builds.
- An existing Mac is no longer mistaken for a new device when its legacy Keychain item is temporarily unavailable. - Paid licenses affected by duplicate device seats from Hibiscus 0.8.11–0.8.16 can now recover safely by activating again with the original license key. - Normal two-Mac seat limits and verified device management remain unchanged.
